content.value: A rectangular plate bounded by the lines $x = 0 , y = 0 , x = \cdot a ,$ and $y = b$ has an initial distribution of temperature given by $F { \bigl ( } x , y { \bigr ) } = B \sin { \frac { \pi x } { a } } \sin { \frac { \pi y } { b } }$ .
